Epic A — Auth · Welcome (/welcome)

Slice the Welcome / verify-email design.

Scope

  • Centered confirmation: mail icon, "Welcome to Villume, {name}!", target email, resend block (captcha + button + status).
  • Light + dark; responsive. Markup only.

Acceptance criteria

  • Matches Welcome.html in both themes, all breakpoints.

Testing scenario (QA)

  1. Compare /welcome to Welcome.html.
  2. Dark mode styling correct.
  3. Mobile layout correct.

Demo by Developer

QA Tester Summary — Issue #1602: Welcome page (/welcome) markup & styles

Suite: qa_testing/tests/e2e/auth/issue_1602_welcome_page_slicing.spec.ts (Playwright - Chromium - source/static contract + dev UI)
Env: Dev https://dev.villume.com with Access-Code header
Status: Failed

Test Scenario & Result

# Box Scenario Given -> Expected Matrix Result
1 White Route and source contract /welcome route, confirmation markup, themed styles, captcha, and resend wiring should exist Source Passed
2 Black Welcome confirmation /welcome with seeded signup history state should show registered name, target email, captcha, and enabled resend after captcha Dev UI Failed
3 Black Dark mode Welcome page should stay readable with .dark theme tokens Dev UI Not reached because scenario #2 failed
4 Black Mobile layout Welcome page should avoid horizontal overflow at 390px width Dev UI Not reached because scenario #2 failed

Bug Notes

  • /welcome renders the shell, but it drops the seeded browser history.state user data on direct route load.
  • The page shows Welcome to Villume! instead of Welcome to Villume, QA Tester!.
  • The target email chip is missing, so the user cannot confirm which email received the verification message.
  • reCAPTCHA callback does not enable the resend button in this state; the button remains disabled.

Passed Checks

  • profile.routes.ts registers path: 'welcome'.
  • welcome.component.html contains the confirmation layout, email binding, captcha host, resend button, and resend status copy.
  • welcome.component.scss uses the scoped .villume-welcome design-token styling for light/dark/responsive layout.

Evidence

  • Video recording captured the failed dev UI path.

Video Recording

issue-1602-welcome-failed-direct-route.mp4

Epic A — Auth · Welcome (/welcome)

Wire Welcome verification + resend.

Scope

  • Personalize name/email from real signup/user context (not URL params).
  • Resend gated by reCAPTCHA with a 30s cooldown countdown; success status.
  • Tie into existing verification flow (/verification → /verified).

Acceptance criteria

  • Correct user shown; resend sends a real email, enforces captcha + cooldown.

Testing scenario (QA)

  1. Arrive after signup → correct name + email shown.
  2. Click Resend without captcha → blocked.
  3. Resend with captcha → email sent; button shows "Resend in 30s" countdown; re-enables after.
  4. Verify via emailed link → lands on verified state.
